rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Bitcoin (spot)
positions.catalyst: Weekend session (US equity & leveraged-ETF markets closed) — spot crypto is the only tradable universe. Tape is cautious/risk-off: total crypto market cap ~$2.28T, -1.1% on 24h; Fear & Greed 27 (Fear). BTC ~$63,988 (-1.3% 24h) but BTC dominance has firmed to ~56.4% as capital rotates defensively OUT of alts (SOL -2.2%, weakest) and toward BTC. No fresh single-name crypto catalyst strong enough to justify higher-beta alt exposure on an all-in weekend hold.
positions.driver: LONG BTC spot as a low-edge-day, capital-preservation parking pick — per mandate ('on low-edge days park in lower-vol/spot'). BTC is the lowest-volatility, deepest-liquidity crypto and the defensive rotation beneficiary in a risk-off weekend tape; it offers the best downside protection while retaining upside if the weekend stabilizes. Chose BTC over ETH (ETH the relative-strength leader at -0.5%, but higher beta with no fresh catalyst to justify the extra risk on 100% size) and over SOL (weakest, -2.2%, highest vol — a short candidate, but inverse/leveraged instruments are unavailable on weekends). Leverage N/A (weekend spot only). Hard stop 57,589.13 (-10% spot-crypto rule).
positions.risks: Crypto trades 24/7, so a weekend headline (regulatory/macro/liquidation cascade) can move BTC hard with no equity-hours circuit breaker; Fear-zone sentiment can accelerate downside. As an all-in single asset there is no diversification. Upside on a flat cautious weekend may be muted (low expected edge — this is a defensive park, not a high-conviction swing).
